STUDENT GROWTH:
CONSIDERATIONS FOR SUPPLEMENTAL
 STUDENT GROWTH INDICATORS

 Damian W Betebenner, Ayaka Nukui & Kevin Whitman
 Boise, ID March 29th, 2018

BACKGROUND
• As Karlynn mentioned, the student growth model that
 Idaho is implementing is a growth-to-proficiency
 model based upon a 3 year time frame assuming a
 linear trajectory.
• Put another way, Idaho’s growth model is based upon
 scale score gain (i.e., subtraction) with a adequacy
 criterion (i.e., a target) defined by the 3 year linear
 trajectory.

BACKGROUND
• At the March 6th Accountability Task Force meeting the
 model and preliminary results were reviewed.
• The group liked the growth-to-proficiency model but
 expressed concern about preliminary results.
 • The results demonstrated correlations that were
 problematic.
 • The dichotomous results (student met target/student
 didn’t meet target) were too “coarse”.
